name: Embiggen — +1/+1 for each supertype, card type, and subtype it has
notes: Memory: project_embiggen_type_count_fix_2026-04-26. The count is over the target's own type line. Isamaru, Hound of Konda (Legendary Creature - Dog) has 3 (Legendary, Creature, Dog), so 2/2 becomes 5/5. Grizzly Bears (Creature - Bear) would get only 2, and is the untargeted control.
